text.en:
Section 2 of Presidential Decree No. 855 dated December 22, 1975 is hereby amended to read as
"Sec. 2. Authorized Salary Rates. The salary structure for police and fire service personnel of the Integrated
National Police shall consist of the salary in pesos per month which shall be graduated in six scales or steps
within a salary range for each rank, as hereunder indicated:

Implementation. Implementation of the salary rates under this Decree shall be as may be
determined by the President, subject to availability of funds.

Readjustment of Salary. The salary of a member of the Integrated National Police as adjusted
pursuant to Section 2 of Presidential Decree No. 855 shall be readjusted to conform with the preceding
Section 1 hereof, subject to the following guidelines:
(a) In case the salary of any member of the Integrated National Police is equal to or within the first and second
salary step as provided in Section 2 of Presidential Decree No. 855, such salary shall be raised to the rate
corresponding to the first salary step provided for herein.
(b) In case the salary of a member of the Integrated National Police is above the second salary step provided
for in Section 2 of Presidential Decree No. 855, the member concerned shall continue to receive such salary
under the corresponding authorized rank and salary step in accordance with Section 1 hereof.
(c) When the salary of a member of the Integrated National Police prior to the effectivity of Presidential
Decree No. 765 on August 8, 1975 has not been adjusted pursuant to Presidential Decree No. 855, such salary
shall be readjusted in conformity with the guidelines prescribed in Subsection 3a and 3b above.

Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect upon approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 8th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
